REQ-Intro.description: Render the 'About' section with 5 paragraphs and specific external links: Docker curriculum (http://prakhar.me/docker-curriculum), Genius (http://genius.com/Justin-bieber-baby-lyrics), and SF Data (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Mobile-Food-Facility-Permit/rqzj-sfat).

REQ-Sidebar.constructor.description: Initialize Sidebar state with { results: [], query: '', firstLoad: true } and bind onChange, handleSearch, and handleHover methods.
REQ-Sidebar.constructor.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::updates the input value when the user types
missing_aspects: initial state values (results = [], query = '', firstLoad = true) are not asserted

REQ-Sidebar.fetchResults.description: Send a GET request to '/search?q=<query>' using superagent. On success, update state with res.body and set firstLoad to false, then call plotOnMap(). On error, trigger an alert('error in fetching response').
REQ-Sidebar.fetchResults.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::updates the DOM with results after a successful fetch
missing_aspects: verification that plotOnMap() is called after a successful fetch

REQ-Sidebar.generateGeoJSON.description: Convert an array of marker objects into a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Each Feature must include properties { name, hours, address, 'point-color': '253,237,57,1' } and a Point geometry with coordinates built from parseFloat(p.location.longitude) and parseFloat(p.location.latitude).
REQ-Sidebar.generateGeoJSON.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::returns a FeatureCollection with correct features for given markers

REQ-Sidebar.plotOnMap.description: Flatten all truck branches into a marker array. If a vendor name is provided, split markers into highlightMarkers (matching vendor) and usualMarkers (non-matching); otherwise all markers are usualMarkers. Remove existing 'trucks' and 'trucks-highlight' layers and sources before re-adding. Add a 'trucks' circle layer (yellow rgba(253,237,57,1)). If highlightMarkers exist, add a 'trucks-highlight' circle layer (pink rgba(164,65,99,1)).
REQ-Sidebar.plotOnMap.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::adds only the usual trucks source/layer when no vendor is provided

REQ-Sidebar.handleSearch.description: Prevent default form submission and call fetchResults().
REQ-Sidebar.handleSearch.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::submits query, fetches results and renders result summary

REQ-Sidebar.onChange.description: Update state.query with the current input value from the change event.
REQ-Sidebar.onChange.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::updates the input value when the user types

REQ-Sidebar.handleHover.description: Call plotOnMap(vendorName) to highlight the hovered vendor's locations on the map.
REQ-Sidebar.handleHover.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::delegates to plotOnMap with the supplied vendor name and adds highlight layers

REQ-Sidebar.render.firstLoad.description: When firstLoad is true, render only the search form and the <Intro /> component.

REQ-Sidebar.render.results.description: When firstLoad is false, render the search form and, if resultsCount > 0, a results area showing hit count, location count, and a list of <Vendor> components.
REQ-Sidebar.render.results.test_reference: Sidebar.test.js::updates the DOM with results after a successful fetch
missing_aspects: search form not verified to render after firstLoad becomes false
list of <Vendor> components not verified to be rendered

REQ-Vendor.constructor.test_reference: Vendor.test.js::toggles expanded state and updates displayed food items

REQ-Vendor.toggleExpand.description: Toggle state.isExpanded between true and false on each click, causing formatFoodItems to re-evaluate and update the displayed food item list.

REQ-Vendor.render.description: Render a <li> with onMouseEnter calling handleHover(name) and onClick calling toggleExpand. Display truck name, branch count with a pin icon, optionally a 'Serves Cold Drinks' row if drinks is true, and the formatted food items with fork/spoon icons.

REQ-formatHTMLforMarker.description: Build and return an HTML string for a Mapbox popup using props.name, props.hours, and props.address. Renders a '.marker-title' div for the name, an 'Operating Hours' h4 with a span, and an 'Address' h4 with a span.
REQ-formatHTMLforMarker.test_reference: app.test.js::should return correctly formatted HTML for typical props

REQ-app.mapboxSetup.description: Initialize a Mapbox GL map centered on San Francisco ([-122.44, 37.77]) at zoom 12, using the specified access token and custom map style.
REQ-app.mapboxSetup.note: Browser-only: 'app.js' is a browser entry-point and description matches pattern 'access token'. Top-level code executes on require() and crashes in Node.js. Use Cypress or Playwright for E2E coverage.

REQ-app.mapClickTrucks.description: On map click, query features on the 'trucks' layer within radius 10. If a feature is found, display a Mapbox popup at the feature's coordinates with HTML from formatHTMLforMarker.
REQ-app.mapClickTrucks.note: Browser-only: type='event-handler' in entry-point 'app.js'. Not inside an exported function — executes on require(). Use Cypress or Playwright for E2E coverage.

REQ-app.mapClickTrucksHighlight.description: On map click, query features on the 'trucks-highlight' layer within radius 10. If a feature is found, display a Mapbox popup at the feature's coordinates with HTML from formatHTMLforMarker.
REQ-app.mapClickTrucksHighlight.note: Browser-only: type='event-handler' in entry-point 'app.js'. Not inside an exported function — executes on require(). Use Cypress or Playwright for E2E coverage.

REQ-app.renderSidebar.description: Mount the <Sidebar map={map} /> React component into the DOM element with id 'sidebar'.
REQ-app.renderSidebar.note: Browser-only: type='initialization' in entry-point 'app.js'. Not inside an exported function — executes on require(). Use Cypress or Playwright for E2E coverage.

REQ-backend.loadDataInEs.description: Fetch food truck data from the SF Gov API (http://data.sfgov.org/resource/rqzj-sfat.json) and index each truck into Elasticsearch under index 'sfdata', doc_type 'truck', using the array index as the document ID.
missing_aspects: no assertion that requests.get is called with the required SF Gov API URL

REQ-backend.safeCheckIndex.description: Check if an Elasticsearch index exists with exponential backoff retry (up to max_retry=6 attempts, sleep 2^retry seconds). Exit the process if max retries are exceeded.
missing_aspects: exponential backoff sleep (2^retry seconds) between retry attempts
verification that retries are performed up to max_retry before succeeding

REQ-backend.formatFooditems.description: Split a food items string on ':' and strip/lowercase each part. If the first element contains 'cold truck', drop it and return the rest; otherwise return all parts.

REQ-backend.searchEndpoint.description: GET /search?q=<key>: Query Elasticsearch for trucks whose 'fooditems' field matches the key. Return JSON with trucks (name, fooditems, branches with hours/schedule/address/location.coordinates, drinks flag), hit count, and location count. Return 400 if no query provided, 500 on ES error.

REQ-backend.menuEndpoint.description: GET /menu: Retrieve all food items from Elasticsearch, count occurrences of each item, return the top 20 by frequency. Supports ?format=json for JSON response or renders menu.html template.

REQ-backend.statsEndpoint.description: GET /stats: Return unique truck count and total locations using Elasticsearch cardinality and value_count aggregations. Supports ?format=json for JSON response or renders stats.html template.

REQ-backend.healthEndpoint.description: GET /health: Return 200 JSON with elasticsearch: 'connected' if ES cluster is reachable, or 503 JSON with elasticsearch: 'disconnected' otherwise.

REQ-backend.randomEndpoint.description: GET /random: Fetch one random truck from Elasticsearch using function_score with random_score. Return truck name, fooditems, address, location, hours, and schedule. Supports ?format=json or renders random.html.

REQ-backend.filterEndpoint.description: GET /filter?cuisine=<cuisine>: Query Elasticsearch for trucks matching the cuisine in fooditems. Return grouped truck list with branches. Return 400 if no cuisine provided, 500 on ES error. Supports ?format=json or renders filter.html.
